$schema-note: Hand-maintained. Data, not code: nothing under src/ imports this file.
purpose: The mutation ledger for WIN-302's three acceptance clauses, run against
`src/composition/context-factories.test.ts` and the suites that share its
subject. One entry per mutation, carrying the file (repository-relative), the
EXACT text removed or changed (`from`), what replaced it (`to`), and the NAMED
cases that were SEEN to go red (`kills`).
CLAUSE 1 -- every context's contract factory resolves from apps/core-api,
proved by import. M09 renames a `.`-route factory in the artifact the runner
resolves; M04-M06 remove a subpath-route entry point.
CLAUSE 2 -- a mutation removing ONE entry point turns a NAMED test red. M04,
M05 and M06 each delete one `./application/index.js` from one manifest, and
each turns that context's own case red while its sixteen siblings stay green.
They were chosen to cover the three import situations the tree has: `channels`
is imported by nothing but its factory-entries module; `tenancy` is also
imported statically by `app.module.ts`; `governance` is also imported
statically by `context-ports.ts`. For the last two, `installation.test.ts`
fails at LOAD, as it did before this tranche. That is why the per-context
cases live in a file that imports neither module at its top.
CLAUSE 3 -- no stale count survives, and a readback stops the next one. M01
and M02 put the pre-WIN-302 figure back into the prose of the two files the
WIN-302 comment names. M03 moves the constant and leaves the prose alone. M08
restores both files exactly as they stood at the branch base 3f422333, which
is the state the readback exists to have caught.
A SEPARATE FILE FROM `mutations-win267-g3.json`, which recorded the partition
this tranche replaced. Its kill names for G3-M05..G3-M09 name a case that no
longer exists, and that ledger's `retiredKills` says where each property is
held now, rather than rewriting what was measured at ff06655f.
procedure: Base: tejas/m2m4-lane-factories, the tree of the commit that carries this file
installation.test.ts. Re-confirmed green after the sweep.
Each mutation was applied to the working tree from a byte copy, the suite run,
and the copy restored. `git status` showed the tree unchanged after each.
M09 edits `dist/`, which is gitignored, and was restored the same way. M10 also
WHY NO ENTRY IS A MODULE-LOAD FAILURE OF THE FILE UNDER TEST. Before this file
existed, the obvious instrument was probed and REFUSED: a literal
fails in Vite's import-analysis TRANSFORM when the manifest does not publish
specifier`, `Tests  no tests`). That is a vacuous red. The same probe through a
relative module that re-exports the factory failed ONE case and passed its
siblings, which is the shape `factory-entries/` implements.
